card.name: Words in goal or plan statements
card.fires_on: Words inside plans, goals or intentions in general web text, such as 'My goal is', 'I would like to generate', 'plant medicinal plants'. It fires on the word that continues a forward-looking aim.

modes.label: Stated goal
modes.description: Words in or right after a statement of what the writer wants to do.
modes.example: My goal<< is>> to create an IDE for a scripting language

modes.label: Planned project
modes.description: Words in descriptions of things people plan to build, grow or create.
modes.example: Feed Fayetteville teamed up to build<< a>> garden for them last month

modes.label: Wish to make something
modes.description: Verbs after 'would like to' that name something to produce.
modes.example: I would like to<< generate>> 256-bits key which

card.writes: It slightly favors words about the future and about scope, such as 'next year' and 'upcoming', in Chinese.
card.plain: It lights up in sentences where someone says what they plan or hope to make or do.
